_note: Connector catalog used by `specanvil connect` and `specanvil init`. Secrets are never written: configs reference environment variables (${VAR}). Package names and URLs reflect the vendors' docs at time of writing; check them before rolling out to a team.

specanvil.description: SpecAnvil code index: outlines, symbol search, budgeted context, spec drift, token savings.

playwright.description: Microsoft Playwright MCP: drive a real browser through the accessibility tree for exploratory testing and E2E generation.

github.description: GitHub official remote MCP: issues, PRs, projects, code search.

jira.description: Jira + Confluence via mcp-atlassian (Cloud or Data Center). Read tickets for grooming, post acceptance criteria back.

atlassian-remote.description: Atlassian's hosted Rovo MCP server (OAuth in browser, no token in config).

azure-devops.description: Microsoft Azure DevOps MCP: work items, boards, repos, pipelines, test plans.

linear.description: Linear hosted MCP (OAuth): issues, projects, cycles.

gitlab.description: GitLab MCP endpoint (issues, MRs, pipelines). Requires a GitLab version with MCP enabled.

postgres.description: Postgres MCP Pro (restricted/read-only mode): EXPLAIN plans, index recommendations, top queries, health checks.

mysql.description: DBHub universal SQL MCP pointed at MySQL/MariaDB. Use a read-only database user.

sqlserver.description: DBHub universal SQL MCP pointed at SQL Server. Use a read-only database user.

sqlite.description: DBHub universal SQL MCP pointed at a SQLite file.

mongodb.description: Official MongoDB MCP in read-only mode: explain plans, indexes, schema sampling.

figma.description: Figma Dev Mode MCP (local, from the Figma desktop app): frames, variables, component code hints.

sentry.description: Sentry hosted MCP (OAuth): errors and traces to ground bug tickets in real data.

context7.description: Up-to-date library documentation lookups, so generated code matches the versions you use.
